authorization_scope: Deterministic prospective-v9 semantic adjudication wrapper carried forward unchanged from v4, exact-span and route validation, auxiliary observer, blocked move-and-manner assignment, production executor, endpoint, analyzer, power, and request-validator readiness only; this certificate authorizes no confirmation-model call, live study, or programme-headroom consumption.
launch_gate: v6 changes what is contrasted, not what is measured. v5 held the tutor move fixed at one discriminating question and contrasted the plain and warm manner: plain recovered 1 of 18, warm 4 of 17, a difference of 0.18 at p = 0.18, and the registered decision was that warm recovery is not confirmed. v6 keeps that same window, which made 35 of 35 scored units reachable, and instead contrasts two tutor moves under the one host action family: ask a discriminating question against simplify to one workable step. The manner is now a balancing block rather than the contrast, split nine and nine inside each move and three and three inside each world, so a move result cannot be a manner result wearing a different name. Three readings are added and none of them is a hypothesis test: the v5 one-turn primary is retained as a descriptive comparability endpoint so the two studies can be read side by side; a learner turn that only says back what the tutor just made public is counted per move and does not count as recovery; and a unit whose delivered move is not its assigned move is nonadherent and fails the interpretability gate rather than being rerun. The instrument earns no fresh accuracy claim: the sealed 55-case held-out v4 corpus is spent and permanently excluded, and its replay here makes no model call. Launch still requires the wholly fresh digest-bound HOLD request with absent create-once destinations, exact digest verification against the standing authorization, prelaunch verification of the 4428-study and 15000-programme operational safeguards, and a separately committed explicit human approval. The completed v4 and v5 studies, the stopped v2 cohort, and the spent v1-v4 validation corpora remain permanently excluded from every v6 outcome.
